derived.layout: loaded XEX image: offset=VA-base, NOT standard PE raw-file layout
derived.derivation: AES-CBC using existing local reference; continuous ciphertext chain, basic data/zero runs; no key bytes retained

value.guest_addresses: 32-bit virtual addresses; not an assertion of 32-bit GPR width
value.calling_convention: Xbox PPC: r1 stack, LR saved across calls, r3 argument/result observed; SDK translates r3-r10 integer arguments and uses 64-bit GPR storage
value.scope: Header/instruction evidence and SDK ABI reference, not complete per-function signature recovery

parser_comparison.finding: Header IDs, basic block reconstruction, PE32 LE metadata, BE import-record dereferencing and ordinal pairing used as reference.
XEX structures/IDs agree; all 269 imported symbol names agree between the local SDK and Xenia ordinal tables.

Reads BE XEX/records and LE PE; import loader modifies its in-memory thunk bytes, and pairs type 1 with preceding type 0 rather than using the SDK ordinal map. Never use modified analysis bytes as original bytes.
Reports entry=0x200 from system flags; labels execution info as TLS, stack as heap, original PE name as address.
Uses address low bits as ordinal without dereferencing the decrypted image; reports 1536 instead of XNotifyGetNext ordinal 651 for the first xam import; version split is also incorrect.

ppc_scan.scope: 4-byte aligned words only in the three executable PE sections; may include embedded data

limitations: No execution, codegen, build, RSA authentication or official dump/TU catalog comparison.
Source comparisons are not runs of the compiled ReXGlue, Xenia or Ghidra loaders.
REA rejected XEX and derived POWERPCBE PE; no native REA session opened.
Opcode-pattern candidates are not exhaustive CFG, function-boundary or indirect-target analysis.
Page SHA1 equality is an exploratory hash comparison, not an authenticated XEX integrity verdict.
Memory-request headers do not establish total RAM/VRAM demand.
No keys, AES session material, assets, binary payloads or private PDB paths are included.
